$comment: Manifest for the codriver app marketplace.
name: Crypto prices
description: Live prices and 24-hour change for the coins you pick, beside the map. Any currency CoinGecko supports.
install_instructions: In codriver.io/account -> Apps -> Crypto prices, list the coins you want using their CoinGecko ids (bitcoin, ethereum, solana...) separated by commas, and pick a currency such as eur or usd. Three coins fit in a slot. Prices refresh about once a minute.

fields.label: Coins
fields.help: CoinGecko ids, comma separated. First three are shown.
